content.value_statement: WooCommerce development often requires focused tests, branch linting, and repeated code quality fixes. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code clear workflows for WooCommerce test, lint, and commit checks.
actual_capabilities: Guides focused PHP unit test runs for classes, methods, directories, and matching patterns.
Explains WooCommerce test environment setup, restart, and troubleshooting commands.
Documents branch-specific PHP, JavaScript, and markdown linting workflows.
Shows common PHP linting fixes for translation comments, headers, alignment, and indentation.
Provides pre-commit checklists for reviewing fixes before committing changes.
limitations: Assumes the user is working inside the WooCommerce repository with project dependencies installed.
Command execution depends on the AI tool permissions and the local development environment.
It does not replace human review of automated lint fixes or test failures.
It does not provide production deployment, security scanning, or release management workflows.

use_cases.title: Validate A PHP Change
use_cases.description: Run focused PHP tests and branch linting after changing WooCommerce server-side code.

use_cases.title: Clean Up Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Fix style issues only in changed files before submitting a WooCommerce pull request.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Test Failures
use_cases.description: Interpret failed test output and choose the next focused command for investigation.

prompt_templates.title: Run Relevant Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check after a small change
prompt_templates.prompt: I changed a WooCommerce PHP class. Help me choose and run the most focused tests for this change.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Branch Linting
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my WooCommerce branch for PHP, JavaScript, and markdown linting issues. Fix only files changed in this branch.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve PHP Standards Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this WooCommerce PHPCS output and apply the correct style fixes without changing unrelated code.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare A Commit Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a WooCommerce pre-commit validation sequence for my current changes, including tests, linting, review steps, and failure handling.

output_examples.input: A developer changed a WooCommerce payment test and asks what to run next.
output_examples.output: The response recommends a focused PHP test run, explains why it matches the changed class, and adds branch linting before commit.

output_examples.input: A contributor receives PHP style errors about translation comments and indentation.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the relevant WooCommerce linting pattern and describes the safe manual fix for each reported issue.

output_examples.input: A maintainer wants a final quality pass before opening a pull request.
output_examples.output: The response lists focused tests, branch-specific lint checks, markdown validation, and review steps for automatic fixes.

best_practices: Run the smallest relevant test set first, then broaden coverage before committing.
Use branch-specific lint commands to avoid changing unrelated WooCommerce files.
Review automatic fixes with a diff before accepting or committing them.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad lint fixes across the entire repository for a narrow change.
Do not ignore manual PHPCS errors after automatic fixes finish.
Do not commit changes before tests and lint checks pass for the affected area.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps run WooCommerce tests, lint changed files, fix common style issues, and prepare changes for commit.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: It provides command workflows. Actual command execution depends on the AI tool, repository state, and user permissions.

faq.question: Can it fix PHP linting errors?
faq.answer: It can guide automatic and manual fixes for documented WooCommerce PHP linting patterns.

faq.question: Does it cover JavaScript tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for JavaScript test commands in WooCommerce client and admin areas.

faq.question: Can it validate markdown files?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes markdown linting guidance, encoding checks, and formatting workflows.

faq.question: Is it useful outside WooCommerce?
faq.answer: Only partly. The commands and conventions are written for the WooCommerce repository.
